run_shuffle_stdin: run shuf.py to randomly shuffle all lines piped from stdin using a default seed of 42
run_shuffle_n_lines: run shuf.py with --num-lines to output only the first n randomly shuffled lines from stdin
run_shuffle_with_seed: run shuf.py with --seed to set a custom random seed for reproducible line shuffling
run_shuffle_subset: run shuf.py to shuffle stdin and output a random subset of lines without replacement
review_main: review the main function that parses args, reads stdin, and shuffles lines using numpy random choice
